jobs.description:
Snapshot of your Day

As a Data Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Process Digitalization Team for Grid Technologies within Siemens Energy. Working closely with more than 30 factories across our global Manufacturing Network, you will contribute to the development and adoption of our secure, centrally governed, and AI-enabled Data Mesh.

Your focus will be on transforming scalable data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and sustainable business growth. By analyzing complex datasets and translating business requirements into analytical solutions, you will drive cross-functional data and analytics initiatives that enhance competitiveness and support the future development of our products and processes. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Conducting in-depth analyses of manufacturing and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement across the business area
* Supporting the definition, development, and continuous refinement of data structures and data products, with a focus on data quality, consistency, and usability
* Collaboration with data engineering and cloud architecture teams to ensure analytical requirements are reflected in data ingestion processes, data models, and platform capabilities
* Development and maintenance of dashboards, KPIs, reports, and lightweight analytical applications to increase transparency and support data-driven decision-making
* Continuous evaluation and optimization of analytical workflows, performance metrics, and reporting processes to enhance operational efficiency and business value creation
* Provision of actionable insights and analytical recommendations to support strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and the adoption of data-driven practices across the organization

What You Bring
* Academic degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field, combined with professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven process optimization
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including hands-on experience with modern data and analytics tools such as Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Alteryx, Python, and SQL
* Expertise in the development of dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting solutions, and data visualizations using leading business intelligence platforms such as Power BI and Tableau
* Solid understanding of cloud-based data ecosystems, preferably Snowflake and AWS, as well as modern data stack concepts including ELT processes and data modeling
* Ability to transform complex datasets into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and decision-relevant information for stakeholders across all organizational levels
* Business fluency in English, strong communication and stakeholder management skills, an international mindset and willingness to travel internationally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
How to contribute to our vision

This role is being created as a new addition to ensure business continuity and provide on-site construction management for new office and industrial build projects in Berlin (DE), as approved by executive leadership. The position is situated within the SE Real Estate's Project Management BSS PM1 team, directly supporting strategic growth initiatives. To successfully deliver these new facilities, the role will focus on three primary areas: hands-on project execution and site management, strategic project planning and risk mitigation, and comprehensive stakeholder communication and coordination. This structure ensures end-to-end control from initial planning through to final delivery, aligning with Siemens Energy's standards. Given the focus on complex office and industrial builds, the ideal candidate will possess specialized expertise in construction management, backed by an advanced degree in a relevant engineering or architectural field. Proven experience in managing large projects, strong stakeholder communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential for success.

What You Need To Make a Difference

* 50% On-Site Construction Management & Execution
+ Lead and manage all on-site activities for major industrial construction projects, ensuring alignment with project timelines and budgets.
+ Oversee contractors and execution teams to guarantee compliance with Siemens Energy's quality standards, sustainability guidelines, and safety protocols.
+ Monitor project progress, conduct site inspections, and resolve any on-site issues to maintain project momentum and quality.
+ Ensure all construction activities adhere to local German legal and operational requirements.
* 30% Project Planning, Strategy & Risk Management
+ Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks (financial, schedule, quality) to prevent delays and cost overruns.
+ Develop and maintain detailed project documentation, including schedules, budgets, and progress reports.
+ Support sustainability initiatives by integrating energy efficiency measures and pursuing green building certifications.
* 20% Stakeholder Management & Digitalization
+ Serve as the primary point of contact and facilitate collaboration between internal teams, external consultants, contractors, and local authorities.
+ Manage communication with all project stakeholders, providing regular updates and ensuring alignment on project goals and milestones.

Certifications

* Project Management Professional (PMP)

Education

* Master’s degree or equivalent in Construction Engineering, Civil Engineering, MEP Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of professional experience managing construction projects for industrial facilities, preferably in an international context.

Skills

* Technical & Engineering
+ Construction Project Management
+ Construction Contract Management
+ Risk Management
+ Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment (QHSE) Standards
+ Office Buildings Design & Construction
* Management & Communication
+ Stakeholder Management
+ Project Planning & Control
+ Budget Management
+ Advanced English Proficiency
+ Advanced German Proficiency
* Qualifications
+ Project Management Methodologies (PMP, IPMA)

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Department Pediatric Neurooncology is looking, starting from 01.11.2026, for a Strategic Officer.

The department led by Prof. Stefan Pfister at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) and the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center Heidelberg (KiTZ) combines international pediatric oncology research with data-driven precision oncology and the development of sustainable research infrastructures.

A key international initiative of the department is the ITCC PedCanPortal, a data and research platform developed in collaboration with leading European partners in pediatric oncology. The project aims to bring together a large, international multi-omics dataset comprising molecular and clinical data from more than 5,000 patients and to make these high-quality research data, along with analytical tools, accessible and sustainably available to the international research community. In doing so, the ITCC PedCanPortal aims to support the development of new diagnostic and therapeutic approaches for children and adolescents with cancer.

The Strategic Officer will work at the interface of science, strategy, international partnerships, and the sustainable development of the ITCC PedCanPortal, with a particular focus on establishing the organizational and financial structures required for its long-term sustainability.

Your Tasks

As Strategy Officer, you will be embedded within the central coordination structure of ITCC PedCanPortal and work closely with the project leadership, international consortium partners, patient representatives, advisory bodies, and external stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to develop, coordinate, and implement a comprehensive long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal beyond its current funding period (e.g., via a non-profit spin-off). Sustainability planning will be treated as a continuous and evolving process, closely aligned with the scientific, technical, ethical, and operational development of the platform.

Key responsibilities:

Strategic development and sustainability planning

- Develop and continuously refine a long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal
- Design governance and operational models for the future operation and expansion of the platform
- Evaluate and develop sustainable funding and partnership models
- Support the onboarding of future programs, projects, and stakeholders into the ITCC PedCanPortal ecosystem

Stakeholder management and international coordination

- Coordinate continuity-related activities across a large international consortium
- Facilitate interactions with academic partners, patient representatives, external stakeholders, and industry collaborators
- Support strategic discussions within governance and advisory structures
- Build and maintain strong relationships across the international pediatric oncology community

Governance, reporting, and implementation

- Ensure alignment of continuity planning with scientific, ethical, legal, and operational requirements
- Prepare strategic reports, recommendations, and implementation concepts for project leadership and governance bodies
- Contribute to annual reporting, risk assessment, and long-term planning activities
- Support the translation of strategic concepts into operational implementation plans

Your Profile

We are looking for a highly organized and strategically minded individual who enjoys working at the intersection of science, innovation and international collaboration.

Essential:

- PhD or 5+ years experience in life sciences, medicine, public health, health economics, management, law or a related discipline.
- Experience in scientific program management, research strategy, innovation management, business development or international collaborative projects.
- Excellent organizational and communication skills.
- Experience working with diverse stakeholder groups in complex international environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable:

- Experience with large-scale research infrastructures, data platforms or precision medicine initiatives.
- Understanding of governance, continuity planning and funding strategies.
- Experience in public-private partnerships, translational research or health innovation.
- Familiarity with biomedical research, pediatric oncology, genomics or health data ecosystems.

You can look forward to:

- The opportunity to help shape one of the world's leading pediatric cancer data platforms.
- A highly international and interdisciplinary working environment.
- Close interaction with internationally renowned experts in pediatric oncology, genomics, data science, ethics and patient advocacy.
- A unique strategic role with significant visibility and impact.
- Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
- Flexible working arrangements within a dynamic research environment.
- Join us in building the future of pediatric precision oncology and creating a sustainable international data infrastructure that will improve outcomes for children with cancer worldwide.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!
